# Weak fixture essay (fixture-only synthetic)

## Introduction

This essay asks whose interests count when water is allocated. It looks at a region where allocation is contested and argues that the answer is not obvious.

## Argument

A region under pressure shows the problem. Farmers, towns, and wildlife all depend on the same water, and each claim is real. The essay argues that a fair allocation has to weigh those claims, though it does not name which region it means.

## Conclusion

The essay concludes that allocation is a moral question, not only a technical one.
